headline: Marketplace moves drive the week: H200 index up +12% while B200 slips -5% over 7 days.
bullets: H200's market index rose +12% to $6.02, driven by a +17% marketplace jump while hyperscaler and neocloud medians held at +0%.
B200's index fell -5% to $8.10 as its marketplace median dropped -12% to $7.04, with hyperscaler and neocloud segments unchanged.
H100 SXM's index is flat at +0% ($4.62), but this hides a -10% marketplace decline to $2.21, where Vast.ai is cheapest at $1.73.
H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance among tracked GPUs at $3.54 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of B200 at $3.60 and MI300X at $3.62.
H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +184%, while H100 SXM's hyperscaler median of $10.68 sits +140% above its neocloud median of $4.45.
watch: Whether H200's +17% marketplace rise spreads to neocloud pricing, which has held at +0% over the past 7 days.
